data.name: Risenia
data.gender_notes: Risenia is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'resurgere', which means 'to rise again'. In Christian context, this name symbolizes the resurrection of Jesus Christ and the promise of eternal life. The name Risenia carries the meaning “Resurrection” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Risenia usually hope their child will grow to embody resurrection and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the hope and faith in the resurrection of the dead.
data.etymology: Risenia belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Resurrection.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Risenia total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Risenia holds deep cultural significance for Christians, reminding them of the central tenet of their faith - the resurrection of Jesus Christ. The name carries a strong indication of hope, new beginnings, and the power of transformation, which are fundamental aspects of the Christian belief system.
data.spiritual_significance: On a spiritual level, the name Risenia signifies the triumph of life over death and the promise of eternal life for those who put their faith in God. It is a reminder of the power and love of God, who brings light out of darkness, creation out of chaos, and new life out of death. Through this name, Christians can be inspired to keep their faith strong and their hope alive, even during the most difficult times in their lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Risenia symbolizes new life and resurrection in Christ. It is a reminder of the power and triumph of God over death and sin. May the one named Risenia continue to live in the spirit of the risen Lord.

historical_references.reference: Risenia, a Christian bishop in Lower Pannonia, was martyred during the Diocletian Persecution in the late 3rd century.
historical_references.context: Risenia was a bishop in the Roman province of Lower Pannonia during the Diocletian Persecution. He was martyred for his faith.

historical_references.reference: The city of Risenia, also known as Razan or Razanah, was an important Christian center in Syria during the 5th century.
historical_references.context: The city of Risenia, located in the Roman province of Syria, was an important Christian center during the 5th century. It was a site of pilgrimage for Christians and played a significant role in the spread of Christianity in the region.
